stories.title: Wildfires in south-west France flare up as region braces for new 40C heatwave
stories.body: Firefighters are braced for a sharp rise in temperatures on Wednesday, which could complicate the containment of wildfires in Gironde.

stories.title: Uefa and PM criticise Infantino World Cup plan
stories.body: Uefa and Prime Minister Andy Burnham criticise proposals from Fifa to seek private investment in its competitions, including the World Cup.

stories.title: Ghana mourns its tallest man - a 'generous and popular giant'
stories.body: Sulemana Abdul Samed, who was diagnosed with gigantism several years ago, has died at the age of 33.

stories.title: Mysterious deaths of 14 elephants in Kenya prompts urgent inquiry
stories.body: It is the highest number of elephant deaths to be recorded in this area of southern Kenya in decades.

stories.title: Odyssey translator writes scathing review of Nolan film adaptation
stories.body: The film has won rave reviews from film critics but a translator of Homer's work was less than impressed.

stories.title: The cocaine superhighway from Ecuador to Europe - the BBC reports on gangs and the police fightback
stories.body: The BBC goes on patrol with Ecuador's police, who are grappling with a huge surge in drug crime.

stories.title: US walks out of UN Security Council meeting during France's remarks
stories.body: The row sparked after the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending the term of the UN high commissioner for human rights.

stories.title: 'A lover of life' - Seattle pays tribute to food festival shooting victims
stories.body: Families grieved on Monday as they remembered the three people killed in a shooting at a food festival.

stories.title: 'A narcissist': Victim's family hits out at Kohberger for challenging murder conviction
stories.body: The man accused of killing four students in Idaho is taking back his plea, which was made to avoid the death penalty.

stories.title: Hong Kong activist allowed to stay in UK after deportation threat
stories.body: Wu was detained for hours at London's Heathrow Airport last week and refused entry, he told the BBC.

stories.title: French Navy carries out 'shooting drill' mid interview
stories.body: Shadow Home Secretary Chris Philp says the vessel fired 17 shots as he was giving a BBC interview.

stories.title: Mancini reappointed Italy boss after Pirlo controversy
stories.body: Roberto Mancini is appointed Italy manager for a second time - just a day after Andrea Pirlo rules himself out of the running for the job and technical director Paolo Maldini resigns.

stories.title: Johnson & Johnson offers up to $5.5bn to settle baby powder lawsuits
stories.body: The proposed settlement aims to close a years-long legal battle over claims its talcs products cause cancer.

stories.title: Ariana Grande sues hackers who leaked music and videos
stories.body: The pop star is suing to discover the identity of hackers who obtained unreleased photos and songs.

stories.title: Zoo staff rescue near-extinct snails from remote rock
stories.body: Just 21 Madeiran land snails were found clinging to a rock on Portugal's Bugio Island, say conservationists.

stories.title: Zidane confirmed as France head coach
stories.body: Former Real Madrid manager Zinedine Zidane has been confirmed as the head coach of the France national team.

stories.title: US singer D4vd to go on trial for murder in death of 14-year-old
stories.body: The star is accused of killing Celeste Rivas Hernandez, whose remains were found in a Tesla registered to his address.

stories.title: Number of suspects in fatal Seattle food festival shooting rises to three
stories.body: One suspect is in custody, while a second is being sought and a third is thought to have died at the scene, court documents show.

stories.title: Shots fired at US consulate in Toronto for a second time this year
stories.body: Police said they engaged in a high-speed car chase but failed to arrest the suspect, who remains at large. Three people were arrested in June after a similar attack.

stories.title: Japan earthquake: What we know so far
stories.body: Japan is reeling from a major earthquake that hit Kyushu island. Here is what we know so far.

The ensemble's cautious mood reflects these dualities, suggesting that while positive actions are emerging, they are insufficient to offset broader systemic risks.
